title: Go App Builder
summary: Plan and build Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and browser editions with shared Go logic, usable platform adapters, offline checks, and verified release artifacts.
concept: Shared Go logic and portable formats connect Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and browser adapters, with common open, cancel, save, clear, and release checks.
use: Inspect my existing project and requested platforms before choosing a shared Go core, native adapters, or browser implementation. Read the relevant platform references linked from the skill before making those decisions; identify any unavailable references rather than claiming to have read them. Preserve working behavior, build a feature-parity and compatibility matrix, apply the four VCC review tracks, and verify offline behavior and the actual packaged artifacts. If only planning or review is requested, stay within that mode. Use the project prompt when I want a new build. No persistent skill installation is needed for this immediate-use request.

title: Audiobook Maker
summary: Prepare faithful PDF, EPUB, or text listening editions, with traceable notes, content checks, and an optional free local audio path.
concept: Source chapter text sits beside a checked listening edition, with mapped notes and a path through a local voice to WAV, MP3, or M4B audio.
credit: Original workflow by Lance Eaton; adapted for VCC by Miguel Guhlin.
use: Prepare an authorized text for listening while preserving the author's prose, unique content, citations, and traceable notes. Establish available tools and essential content choices, pilot a representative section, and reconcile retained content throughout each chapter. If I request audio, read the included free local audio reference, use an authorized local voice workflow, and verify a short sample before full synthesis. Distinguish actual generated files and listening checks from plans or unavailable capabilities.
